steps.summary: Signed in as admin/admin (skipped the password change prompt), opened the "Service health" dashboard, and found exactly 3 panels titled: "Request rate", "Error count", and "Latency by endpoint".
Replayed stored procedure s_16cc25; observed dashboard_title=rpgr12-r2 Bench Dashboard, panel_title=rpgr12-r2 Availability.

Replayed stored procedure s_4b22da; observed panel_title=rpgr12-r2 Notes, panel_text_content=Notes for run rpgr12-r2, url=http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/dfx61hrwmk5q8a/rpgr12-r2-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&showCategory=Panel%20options, dashboard_title=rpgr12-r2 Bench Dashboard, other_panel_title=rpgr12-r2 Availability.

Opened 'rpgr12-r2 Bench Dashboard', went to Edit > Settings > General, added the tag 'bench' (saw it appear with a Remove button), saved dashboard settings. Then set time range to 'Last 6 hours' via the time picker (already was showing Last 6 hours from the replayed steps). Saved the dashboard via the save dialog with 'Update default time range' checkbox checked — got "Dashboard saved" alert. After saving, the tag 'bench' was visible in the dashboard settings Tags section, and the top bar shows "Time range selected: Last 6 hours".

Set the auto-refresh interval to 1m via the refresh picker (the previous attempt's click on the "1 minute" menu item had already taken effect — the picker showed "1m" and the URL carried refresh=1m). Saved the dashboard via the save dialog, ticking the "Update default refresh value" checkbox (the dialog showed "No changes to save" until the checkbox created 1 change), and confirmed the "Dashboard saved" alert. Then reloaded the dashboard URL and verified: the refresh picker shows "1m" (button "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected"), the top bar time range shows "Last 6 hours", and the URL is http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bfx5j0ewyyku8a/rpgr12-r2-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now.

Verified the dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/dfx61hrwmk5q8a/rpgr12-r2-bench-dashboard: (1) Dashboard title in breadcrumb: "rpgr12-r2 Bench Dashboard". (2) Panel titles: "rpgr12-r2 Notes" (text panel containing "Notes for run rpgr12-r2") and "rpgr12-r2 Availability" (Stat panel showing value "69.0"). (3) Time range in top bar: "Last 6 hours". (4) Auto-refresh interval: "1m". (5) Opened dashboard Settings (gear icon) - tags listed: "bench". Then closed settings and returned to dashboard view. No changes were made.
